title: A back yard in Chestnut Mountain, Georgia, USA - Cicadas, round midnight
author: JK Johnson
notes: Night insect chorus, 22 Jul 2018 23:11, back yard in the north Georgia foothills (Chestnut Mountain). Lossless 44.1 kHz stereo FLAC, wide (LR corr ~0.24). Katydid rasps pulse in alternating bursts at 3.4-5 and 10-16 kHz over steady cricket trills at ~2.2 and ~5.5 kHz. No frogs, voices, dogs or engines above 1 kHz. title: Simpson Lake Shore, Valley Park, Missouri, USA - Simpson Lake Shore
author: Pierrot Desperes
notes: Small waves lapping at a lake shore (Simpson Lake, Valley Park, Missouri, 24 Dec 2020), lossless 44.1 kHz stereo FLAC. Soft, irregular lapping splashes (300 Hz-14 kHz) with a faint rustle of dry grass. It is quiet (-39 LUFS), so normalise it and keep it low in the mix.
